name: l4_air_radial_shear_hysteresis_control_v1
description: Supported-chassis unloaded control for the L4 planted radial-shear test. Keep L4 retracted at y=60 mm and replay the same x=180 to 187.5 to 195 mm three-cycle timing and 3 s midpoint dwells. This distinguishes unloaded servo/geartrain hysteresis from ground-load-dependent compliance. Soft torque 700; trip after three consecutive readings above 0.75 A; immediate ceiling 3.0 A. Adjacent legs L3/L5 ease to -35/+35 deg yaw to clear the camera view, then return to zero.
